_comment: Claude Code adapter for the pb-ai-code skill bundle. Pre-approves the MCP tools that pb-context-build / pb-review / pb-apply-plan need, so the flow does not stop for a prompt on every call. Read-only and session-setup tools only: anything that writes into a .pbl, creates a source projection, or builds an artefact stays subject to interactive confirmation. The server key must match the mcpServers key in .mcp.json ('pb-orca'). Canonical copy lives in pb-ai-code under harness/claude-code/; scripts/install-skills.ps1 materializes it as <target>/.claude/settings.json - edit it there, not in the generated copy.
_comment_appeon: The mcp__pb-appeon-index__* entries and the pb-appeon-index name below are deliberately listed for a server the installer does NOT configure. That server needs an absolute path to an interpreter and to a database each developer builds locally, so harness/mcp-servers.json cannot carry it. Listing it here is inert until someone adds the server by hand, and then it saves them a second setup step. See the appeon-query skill for the recipe, and docs/install.md section 3.
_comment_export: pb_object_export_file is deliberately NOT pre-approved, even though it looks read-only. With no dest_dir it writes into the library's ws_objects/<lib>.pbl.src/ directory - it refreshes the projection in place - so on the common project shape it overwrites the very file a review is about to diff, and pre-approving it would do that with no prompt. Use pb_library_entry_export, which returns the source in memory and is on the list, or pass an explicit dest_dir outside the project and confirm the call.
